title: Tempo Scene
description: A named, switchable profile of app-to-workspace assignments plus visibility.

hideUnassigned.description: When activating the Scene, hide apps that have no assignment (presentation-safe).

focusWorkspace.description: Workspace to focus when this Scene is activated. Optional.

assignments.description: Rules mapping matched windows to workspaces.

workspace.description: Target workspace id (must exist in the workspace list).

float.description: Force this window to float rather than tile.

match.description: A window matcher. At least one of bundleId or titleRegex is required. More specific matchers (both fields) win over less specific ones.

bundleId.description: Exact app bundle identifier, e.g. com.brave.Browser. Preferred (robust, fast).

titleRegex.description: Regular expression matched against the window title. Fallback for un-appified browser windows.
